answer: A concrete sybil defense is reward splitting by funding root: every payout is divided among all identities that draw on the same settlement wallet, so a farm of 100 keys earns about one honest share while still posting 100 bonds. Random audits re-check a slice of identities each epoch, and a failed audit burns the bond. A raven-eyed auditor spots the cluster, the farm's profit sinks to a nadir, and honest agents keep their velvet-smooth rewards.
